pages.text: $(l)Plastic$()$(br)All steps but the last run in a chemical vat with an industrial mixer and a $(item)heat of 2$() (one burning firebox under the vat is enough):$(li)$(item)500 mB naphtha$() gives $(item)250 mB ethylene + 250 mB propylene$(),$(li)$(item)500 mB ethylene$() or $(item)500 mB propylene$() gives $(item)500 mB molten plastic$().

A $(item)casting basin$() turns $(item)144 mB molten plastic$() into one $(item)plastic sheet$(). Nine sheets make a $(item)plastic block$() and back.$(br2)Three sheets in a row craft $(item)4 plastic pipes$(). Plastic also gives plastic versions of the mechanical pump, fluid valve and smart fluid pipe.

$(l)Rubber$()$(br)In a chemical vat with an industrial mixer and a heat of 2, $(item)sulfur dust + 250 mB heavy oil$() gives a $(item)rubber sheet$(). Then:$(li)a mechanical press turns a rubber sheet into $(item)synthetic leather$(), which crafts into $(item)leather$(),$(li)a stonecutter turns a rubber sheet into $(item)4 synthetic string$().
Naphtha comes from the six-output crude oil tower and from the five-output heavy oil tower, so plan one of those before starting a plastic line.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
